Improved mechanical properties and energy absorption of Ti6Al4V laser powder bed fusion lattice structures using curving lattice struts

High AM Biomedical Materials openalex Direct Read now mechanical_testing Exp. validation
Long Bai, Yue Xu, Xiaohong Chen, Liming Xin, Junfang Zhang et al. Materials & Design 2021-10-01 10.1016/j.matdes.2021.110140
单位: State Key Laboratory of Mechanical Transmission, Chongqing University, 400044 Chongqing, China
通讯: Long Bai @ State Key Laboratory of Mechanical Transmission, Chongqing University, 400044 Chongqing, China
相关性: 该论文直接研究了LPBF制造的Ti6Al4V多孔晶格结构的力学性能提升，与用户关注的AM生物医学植入物方向高度相关。
边界: This paper does not explicitly link porous structure to stress shielding or stiffness matching for biomedical implants, nor does it report surface roughness, as-built morphology, or osseointegration.
动机· 解决晶格结构节点处应力集中问题，提升力学性能。
方法· 提出弯曲支柱晶格设计策略，结合LPBF制备、SEM、准静态压缩实验和FEA分析。
结果· 弯曲晶格结构比弹性模量和比抗压强度最大提升213.7%和126.2%，能量吸收能力提升92.9%。
验证· 通过准静态压缩实验和FEA验证力学性能提升。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To address the critical issue of stress concentration at strut nodes in lattice structures, which limits their mechanical performance.
Method· A curving lattice design strategy using circular or elliptical arcs was proposed, and samples were fabricated by laser powder bed fusion (LPBF) and characterized via SEM, quasi-static compression tests, FEA, and Gibson-Ashby models.
Result· The curving lattice structures achieved up to 213.7% and 126.2% increases in specific elastic modulus and specific compressive strength, respectively, along with a 92.9% improvement in energy absorption capacity.
Validation· Mechanical properties were validated through quasi-static uniaxial compressive experiments and finite element analysis.

A systematic review of preclinical in vivo testing of 3D printed porous Ti6Al4V for orthopedic applications, part I: Animal models and bone ingrowth outcome measures.

Medium AM Biomedical Materials pubmed Peripheral Background only none Review
Hannah Spece, Cemile Basgul, Caleb E Andrews, Daniel W MacDonald, Mitra L Taheri et al. Journal of biomedical materials research. Part B, Applied biomaterials 2021-10-01 10.1002/jbm.b.34803
单位: Implant Research Core, School of Biomedical Engineering, Science and Health Systems, Drexel University, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, USA.
通讯: Steven M Kurtz @ Implant Research Core, School of Biomedical Engineering, Science and Health Systems, Drexel University, Philadelphia, Pe [推断]
相关性: 这篇综述总结了多孔Ti6Al4V骨长入的动物模型与定量指标，但未涉及应力遮挡、疲劳或表面形貌等用户关注的核心问题。
边界: This paper is a systematic review of animal models and bone ingrowth outcomes, and does not include LPBF fabrication, mechanical testing (static or fatigue), stress shielding analysis, surface roughness, or as-built morphology characterization.
动机· 系统回顾3D打印多孔Ti6Al4V在骨科应用的临床前动物测试方法。
方法· 检索58篇文献，分析动物模型与骨长入定量指标。
结果· 兔和羊股骨髁缺损模型最常用，骨长入范围3.92-53.4%。
验证· 基于已发表的临床前研究系统评价，无新实验验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· This systematic review aims to synthesize preclinical animal models and quantitative outcome measures for evaluating bone ingrowth into 3D printed porous Ti6Al4V orthopedic implants.
Method· A systematic literature search identified 58 articles, which were analyzed for animal models and reported bone ingrowth metrics.
Result· Rabbit and sheep femoral condyle defect models are most common, with bone ingrowth ranging from 3.92% to 53.4% and bone-implant contact from 9.9% to 59.7%.
Validation· The study is a review of existing literature and does not conduct new experimental validation; it synthesizes findings from multiple preclinical studies.

In vitro behavior of bioactive hybrid implant composed of additively manufactured titanium alloy lattice infiltrated with Mg-based alloy.

Medium AM Biomedical Materials pubmed Direct Save for project in_vitro Exp. validation
Tohar Perets, Noa Ben Ghedalia-Peled, Razi Vago, Jeremy Goldman, Amnon Shirizly et al. Materials science & engineering. C, Materials for biological applications 2021-10-01 10.1016/j.msec.2021.112418
单位: Department of Materials Engineering, Ben-Gurion University of the Negev, Beer-Sheva 8410501, Israel.
通讯: Jeremy Goldman @ Biomedical Engineering Department, Michigan Technological University, Houghton, MI 49931, USA. Electronic address: jgold
相关性: 该论文研究了一种由增材制造钛合金点阵与可降解镁合金复合而成的生物活性植入体，与用户关于AM生物医学材料的关注点相关，但未涉及疲劳、应力遮挡和表面粗糙度。
边界: No fatigue testing, no stress shielding analysis, no surface roughness characterization.
动机· 开发一种结合永久性钛点阵与可降解镁合金的生物活性混合植入体，以促进骨整合。
方法· 通过增材制造制备Ti-6Al-4V点阵并填充Mg-2.4Nd-0.6Y-0.3Zr合金，进行微观结构、力学、电化学和细胞毒性测试。
结果· 混合植入体具有较高的抗压强度和屈服点，细胞活性在70-120%之间，无细胞毒性。
验证· 通过压缩力学测试、电化学腐蚀测试和间接细胞活性分析进行验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To develop a bioactive hybrid implant combining a permanent titanium lattice with a biodegradable Mg-based alloy for enhanced osseointegration.
Method· A Ti-6Al-4V lattice fabricated via additive manufacturing was infiltrated with a Mg-2.4Nd-0.6Y-0.3Zr alloy, and characterized by microstructure analysis, compressive testing, electrochemical corrosion tests, and cytotoxicity assays.
Result· The hybrid implant exhibited high ultimate compressive strength and yield point, with cell viability in the 70-120% range, indicating non-cytotoxic behavior.
Validation· Validation was performed through mechanical compression tests, potentiodynamic polarization and EIS for corrosion, and indirect cell viability analysis.

Influence of porous tantalum scaffold pore size on osteogenesis and osteointegration: A comprehensive study based on 3D-printing technology.

Changqi Luo, Claire Wang, Xiangdong Wu, Xiaoping Xie, Chao Wang et al. Materials science & engineering. C, Materials for biological applications 2021-10-01 10.1016/j.msec.2021.112382
单位: Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, The First Affiliated Hospital of Chongqing Medical University, Chongqing 400016, China; Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, The Second People's Hospital of Yibin, Yib
通讯: Wei Huang @ Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, The First Affiliated Hospital of Chongqing Medical University, Chongqing 400016, Chin  |  Junyi Liao @ Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, The First Affiliated Hospital of Chongqing Medical University, Chongqing 400016, Chin
相关性: 该论文研究了多孔钽支架孔径对成骨和骨整合的影响，但缺乏力学性能测试和疲劳分析，与用户关注方向部分相关。
边界: This paper does not include mechanical testing (static or fatigue), stress shielding analysis, or surface roughness characterization, which are key to implant performance in the user's direction.
动机· 探究多孔钽支架孔径对骨缺损修复的影响。
方法· 设计并3D打印不同孔径和孔隙率的多孔钽支架，进行体外和体内实验。
结果· 400-600 μm孔径的支架促成骨和骨整合效果最佳。
验证· 体外细胞实验和体内动物植入实验验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To investigate the effect of pore size in porous tantalum scaffolds on osteogenesis and osseointegration for bone defect repair.
Method· Porous tantalum scaffolds with pore sizes of 100-200, 200-400, 400-600, and 600-800 μm were designed and fabricated via 3D printing, and evaluated through in vitro cell studies and in vivo animal implantation.
Result· Scaffolds with pore size of 400-600 μm exhibited superior cell adhesion, proliferation, osteogenic differentiation, and bone ingrowth.
Validation· Validation was performed through in vitro cell assays and in vivo implantation in animal models, complemented by computational fluid dynamics analysis.

Motivation· To investigate the effect of SLM process parameters on the microstructure and compressive properties of NiTi shape memory alloy.
Method· NiTi samples were fabricated by SLM at laser powers of 150W, 210W, and 270W, and characterized by XRD, DSC, optical microscopy, and compression testing.

相关性: 该论文提出的条件深度高斯过程方法在不确定性量化和模型表达能力方面具有优势，可迁移至生物力学代理模型构建。
边界: The paper focuses on a novel Bayesian deep learning method but does not apply it to FEA surrogate modeling, implant design, or biomechanics, and lacks validation on engineering simulation benchmarks.
动机· 结合深度学习表达力与高斯过程不确定性，避免过拟合。
方法· 提出条件深度高斯过程，通过超数据学习近似边际似然。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To combine the expressive power of deep learning with Gaussian Process uncertainty while avoiding overfitting from deterministic feature extractors.
Method· Proposes conditional Deep Gaussian Process (DGP) where intermediate GPs are supported by hyperdata, learned via empirical Bayes by optimizing approximate marginal likelihood.
Result· Demonstrates superior extrapolation performance compared to GP kernel composition, DGP variational inference, and deep kernel learning.
Validation· Validated on synthetic regression benchmarks with comparison to baseline methods.

相关性: 该论文将机器学习与知识约束结合用于制造工艺优化，其方法可迁移至生物力学设计中的昂贵仿真采样优化。
边界: This paper focuses on perovskite solar cell manufacturing, not on FEA surrogate modeling or implant/biomechanics design, and lacks uncertainty quantification for point predictions.
动机· 加速钙钛矿太阳能电池制造工艺优化，降低实验成本。

Motivation· To accelerate the optimization of high-dimensional parameter spaces in perovskite solar cell manufacturing with limited experimental budgets.
Method· A sequential learning framework integrating probabilistic knowledge constraints from prior data, human observations, and Bayesian optimization with adaptive local exploration.
Result· Achieved 18.5% efficiency and identified 10 process conditions yielding >17% efficiency, with a 5x higher success rate than Latin hypercube sampling.
Validation· Validated through virtual benchmarking against traditional design-of-experiments methods and real-world RSPP experiments.

动机· 比较Bristow和Latarjet术后关节内应力分布，解释并发症差异。
方法· 基于CT数据建立肩关节有限元模型，模拟25%骨缺损并移植喙突，分析等效应力。

Motivation· To compare intra-articular stress distribution between modified Bristow and Latarjet procedures and relate it to postoperative complication rates.
Method· Patient-specific 3D finite element models of the glenohumeral joint were developed from CT data, with a 25% glenoid defect and coracoid transfer in standing (Bristow) or lying-down (Latarjet) positions.
Result· Both procedures reduced mean equivalent stress in glenoid cartilage but created new stress concentrations in humeral head cartilage; proximal coracoid graft showed stress shielding in Latarjet, while high screw stress was observed in Bristow.
Validation· Six patient-specific models were analyzed with elastic finite element analysis and statistical comparison.

Motivation· To compare radiological methods for measuring acetabular anteversion and assess their correlation with functional outcomes after total hip arthroplasty.
